name: Craft Agents
description: Runs multiple agent sessions in a desktop workspace for knowledge workers, connecting MCP servers, REST APIs, and local files without config files.

skills.name: Source Connection
skills.description: Adds MCP servers, REST APIs, or local files as sources on request, reading their docs and setting up credentials.

skills.name: Multi-Session Inbox
skills.description: Organizes parallel agent sessions in an inbox with status workflows, flags, and saved conversation history.

skills.name: Permission Modes
skills.description: Switches between Explore (read-only), Ask to Edit, and Auto modes with customizable rules.

skills.name: Automations
skills.description: Starts agent sessions automatically on label changes, schedules, tool use, and other events.

skills.name: Headless Server
skills.description: Runs sessions on a remote server that the desktop thin client or the craft-cli terminal client connects to.
